Name: James, Brother of the Lord
Summary: James, the brother of the Lord, is named by Paul as one who saw the risen Christ and as a pillar of the Jerusalem church alongside Peter and John. He is traditionally identified as the author of the Epistle of James, and is distinct from James son of Zebedee and James son of Alphaeus.

RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; John the Apostle; Paul; Jude, Brother of James
LifeLesson: The brother who once doubted became a pillar; grace can turn family scepticism into steadfast faith.
